children: Mike Wilson thinks the bull market has enough momentum to continue for a fifth year in 2027.
Morgan Stanley's chief U.S. equity strategist raised his 12-month S&P 500 target to 8,700 from 8,000. The new higher target implies upside of 15% from Friday's close of 7,561.67.

"Healthy EPS growth, lower oil, stabilizing rate volatility, continued AI investment and adoption as well as valuations below fair value support the 2027 outlook," Wilson wrote to clients. "We see the mid cycle transition now ending with a more stable mid cycle backdrop evolving in 2027. Growth remains healthy though its rate of change moderates as the initial operating leverage benefit matures, and the Fed normalizes toward less accommodative policy."

Wilson's bullish call comes with stocks in a rough patch. The S&P 500 is down nearly 3% over the past three months on concern over the sustainability of the artificial intelligence trade. Worries about tighter monetary policy from the Federal Reserve have also weighed on stocks, as elevated oil prices drive up the cost of consumer goods and services.
The Wall Street strategist said the recent pullback creates a buying opportunity.

"Our view dating back to late September has been that the correction associated with the mid cycle transition would conclude with the S&P 500 catching down to narrow breadth. That process is now well advanced as the index has approached our established 7,100–7,300 support range," he said. "While a retest could still lie ahead, the recent correction provides the springboard for the next leg higher toward our new 8,700 base case."
The S&P 500 hit a closing low of 7,353.73 earlier this month before rebounding.

Wilson reiterated his preference for stocks with strong balance sheets, "durable margins and cash generation." He also advised clients to add exposure to more cyclical sectors heading into the new year, particularly industrial stocks.

"Industrials is our top sector pick, supported by improving earnings revisions, broadening backlogs and more attractive valuations after the correction. Parts of Financials and Consumer Discretionary also look attractive with the latter positioned to benefit from lower oil and stabilizing rates," he said.
Other Wall Street strategists are also bullish heading into 2027.

Barclays' Venu Krishna also issued an 8,700 S&P 500 target for next year, although that's down a touch from a previous target of 8,800. "2027 hinges on earnings, and earnings hinge on chips," Krishna said.

title: Morgan Stanley is out with its 2027 outlook for equities. Here’s what the bank expects
